content.text: Explore the lush wonders of Northeast India on a spectacular road trip to satisfy your wanderlust with this 10 days tour package. It is the region of the rising sun and lighted mountains, with snowy foggy peaks, unknown routes, and stunning colourful gompas. Enjoy the moment with an expert driver/guide familiar with the area and have beautiful recollections. Witness the fascinating waterfall that creates a song with the fall in Meghalaya's lush valley. Visit the Beautiful Tawang Monastery, the world's oldest and second biggest monastery. Witness the amazing artificial Umiam Lake in Meghalaya and visit Cherrapunji which is the wettest place on Earth. Head to the border state of Assam and Meghalaya, Bhalukpong and enjoy the best sightseeing locations of Arunachal Pradesh.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Visit the beautiful man-made Umiam Lake en route to Shillong
Witness the amazing waterfalls and mysterious caves of Cherrapunji
Visit Kaziranga and witness many types of fauna species
Head to Bhalukpong, which is the border state of Assam and Arunachal Pradesh
Visit Dirang Monastery and Kalachakra Monastery
Sela Pass and Sela Lake are worth seeing in Tawang
Witness the stunning Nuranang Falls of Tawang
Proceed to the War Memorial after seeing Urgelling Gompa, the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama
Witness the Tawang artisan centre, which sells stunning masks, handwoven rugs, and other items
Enjoy a boat cruise on the amazing Brahmaputra River
The Botanical Garden and State Zoo, Regional Science Centre, and Assam State Museum are all worth seeing in Guwahati.

main.title: Amazing Meghalaya Assam and Arunachal Pradesh Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival and Pickup
items: On arrival at Guwahati Airport/Railway Station, meet our representative who will greet you warmly.
Transfer to Shillong, stopping at the Umiam Lake for a photo shoot.
After arriving at the hotel, check-in and relax for the evening.

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Tour
items: After your delicious breakfast starts your tour to Cherrapunji.
Visit Shillong Peak in the middle of the journey for a beautiful perspective of the city.
Visit the Elephant Falls, the Garden of Caves, and the mysterious Mawsmai Caves.
Witness the stunning Nohkalikai Falls, Dainthlen Falls and Seven Sister Falls
Appreciate the lovely evening and return back to Shillong.
Check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 3 : Dawki Tour - Shillong
items: Begin your travel to Dawki after breakfast.
Travel to Dawki, and see the crystal clear Umngot River.
Enjoy boating in the Umngot river where the riverbed can be seen from the surface.
Later head to Shillong and check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 4 : Shillong and Laitlum Sightseeing
items: Start your day with your healthy breakfast and head to Laitlum.
Visit Laitlum Canyons and witness the stunning view from its viewpoint.
Thereafter head to Shillong and visit the famous Lady Hydari Park.
In the evening spend some time exploring the local Markets of Shillong
Check-in at your hotel at Shillong

days.title: Day 5 : Shillong - Kaziranga Tour
items: Have your delicious breakfast and travel to Kaziranga.
Check in to your hotels and take rest after the long journey.
In the evening visit the local market of Kaziranga.

days.title: Day 6 : Kaziranga - Bhalukpong
items: Early morning do the Elephant Safari and thereafter the Jeep Safari.
Explore the floura and fauna at the Kaziranga National Park.
Witness the one-horned rhinoceros and the tiger.
Later head to Bhalukpong which is on the Assam-Arunachal Pradesh border.
Check in to your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure

days.title: Day 7 : Bhalukpong - Dirang Sightseeing
items: Transfer to Dirang after a mouth-watering breakfast.
Visit Tipi along the route on the banks of the Bharali River.
Upon arrival, check into the hotel.
In the afternoon, visit apple and kiwi farms.
Also, witness the Dirang Monastery and Kalachakra Monastery.
Check-in at your hotel at Dirang.

days.title: Day 8 : Dirang to Tawang
items: After breakfast, go on a captivating road adventure to Tawang.
Enjoy the views of Sela Pass and Sela Lake along the route.
Witness the amazing Nuranang Falls in Tawang.
Arrive at the hotel and check-in.
You have the evening to yourself.

days.title: Day 9 : Tawang Sightseeing
items: Visit Tawang Monastery after a great breakfast.
Visit the Tawang artisan area, which sells stunning masks, handwoven carpets, and silver, coral, and amber jewellery.
Later, pay a visit to Urgelling Gompa, the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama, before heading to the War Memorial.
Evening at leisure.
Check-in at your hotel in Tawang for a restful sleep.

days.title: Day 10 : Bomdila Tour
items: Have a wonderful breakfast when you get up.
Travel to Bomdila and check-in at your hotel.
After relaxing, go to Gontse Rabgyaling Monastery and Thub-Chog Gatsel Ling Monastery.
In the evening, go to the local market and enjoy some free time.
Check-in your hotel for a peaceful sleep.

days.title: Day 11 : Bomdila to Guwahati
items: Have your breakfast and start your tour to Guwahati.
Cross a 1.4-kilometre-long river bridge that offers spectacular views of the Brahmaputra River.
Check into your accommodation and unwind when you arrive.

days.title: Day 12 : Local Sightseeing of Guwahati
items: After your delightful breakfast starts your sightseeing tour of Guwahati.
The Botanical Garden and State Zoo, Regional Science Centre, and Assam State Museum are all worth seeing in Guwahati.
In the evening enjoy the views of beautiful Guwahati city.
Before dark, return to your hotel.

days.title: Day 13 : End of this Tour
items: Proceed to the Guwahati airport or railway station after breakfast.
Leave with a wealth of unforgettable memories.
Departure

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which is beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7 (seven) business days in the customer's bank account.
